items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: That was Joe Bloom's orchestra. ... And what did, did Bloom play any instrument? Did he just conduct? No. Flute. Flute. Flute.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Oh. The one that we got now.
Now? Joe. Darensburg. Yeah. Uh huh. Yeah. Oh shit. Oh no, I can't even know. Do you remember Marty Begard and Albert Nicholas? Oh Albert Nicholas.
